disease.seasonal_pandemic_influenza.name: Seasonal Pandemic Influenza

disease.tropical_vector_fever.name: Tropical Vector-Borne Fever

disease.tropical_vector_fever.cause: Monsoon humidity and tropical wetland vectors

disease.arctic_winter_bronchitis.name: Subarctic Winter Respiratory Wave
disease.arctic_winter_bronchitis.summary: Severe cold-belt respiratory illness amplified by prolonged winter freezes and heating strain.
disease.arctic_winter_bronchitis.cause: Extreme subzero winter stress and cold-climate vulnerability
disaster.tectonic_earthquake.name: Major Tectonic Earthquake
disaster.tectonic_earthquake.summary: Violent seismic rupture damaging regional infrastructure, transport links, and urban housing.
disaster.tectonic_earthquake.cause: Active tectonic fault rupture in mountainous or urban zones

disaster.coastal_typhoon.cause: Warm-season cyclonic storm surge along exposed coastlines

disaster.tsunami_surge.cause: Submarine seismic displacement hitting coastal lowlands
